quote: The operator of a bus, other than a tour bus, shall: Not stand or park such vehicle upon any street at any place other than a bus stop, bus stand or the origin or destination point for the route to which such vehicle is assigned which has been designated in accordance with Section 11.60.010 [DEF-LVMC-11-60-010] of this Chapter.

activation.source_clause: The operator of a bus, other than a tour bus
activation.description: Identify original bus/operator and vehicle class.

obligation.source_clause: Not stand or park such vehicle upon any street at any place other than a bus stop, bus stand or the origin or destination point for the route to which such vehicle is assigned
obligation.description: Join actual stationary event to street, assigned route and exact place.

timing.source_clause: Not stand or park such vehicle
timing.description: Review duration and purpose of each original stationary interval.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Original vehicle class or permit record must identify tour buses.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: stand or park such vehicle upon any street
judgment_calls_needed.note: Original movement, duration, driver and occupancy evidence must distinguish standing or parking from a transient stop.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: which has been designated in accordance with Section 11.60.010 [DEF-LVMC-11-60-010]
judgment_calls_needed.note: Administrative designation for assigned route origin or destination is not supplied.
